final: SELECT AVG(category_avg_quantity), AVG(category_avg_difference), AVG(category_avg_difference - mean_category_difference) FROM (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS category_avg_quantity, AVG(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) AS category_avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY product_type_description HAVING AVG(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) > (SELECT AVG(category_difference) FROM (SELECT AVG(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) AS category_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili2 JOIN Products p2 ON ili2.product_id = p2.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc2 ON p2.production_type_code = pc2.production_type_code GROUP BY product_type_description)) CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(category_difference) AS mean_category_difference FROM (SELECT AVG(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) AS category_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili3 JOIN Products p3 ON ili3.product_id = p3.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc3 ON p3.production_type_code = pc3.production_type_code GROUP BY product_type_description)))
